A '''plague''' broke out on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Delemede/Legends|Delemede]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The Republic [[Delemede governor|governor]] refused to give medical aid to a group of Imperial refugees, though he was later convinced otherwise.
